labExamNodeData(study_code: String!): [LabExamNodeData] @cypher(statement: """
 MATCH (s:study)
 WHERE s.clinical_study_designation = $study_code
 MATCH (s)<-[*1..2]-(c:case)
 MATCH (c)<-[*1..2]-(v:visit)
 MATCH (v)<-[:on_visit]-(le:lab_exam)
 RETURN DISTINCT le {.*}
 """, passThrough: true)
